title: Plunder the Hoard
summary: Plunder the hoard while handling an armed guardian and the task's final visitors.
overview: Plunder the hoard while handling an armed guardian and the task's final visitors.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Expect a pause and renewed attack when the guardian reaches half health.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At half health, the Guardian of the Blades becomes protected, moves to its weapon display and equips a weapon before resuming combat.
The pond interaction requires the quest gem and the proper door target.
The search objective creates an ornate chest; looting it starts Cherie's arrival and Yar`Lir's scripted exchange.

notes: Approval E368. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
